sections.lede: Nazryx is a specialist market data and market entry agency for pharmaceutical manufacturers. We know these markets line by line, and we turn that knowledge into registered, selling products.

sections.title: Market entry is a strategy,
sections.lede: Most manufacturers enter frontier markets on brochures and first replies. The ones who win decide on evidence. That is the whole of our approach.

items.title: Evidence before decisions
items.text: The data already says where a product can win. We read it before anyone commits.

items.title: Every market is its own game
items.text: Different rules, buyers and clocks in each country. Expertise has to be local, or it is guesswork.

items.title: The market belongs to the maker
items.text: We build your position, not ours. Registrations stay in your name, so the market stays yours.

sections.title: Six regions.
sections.lede: Pick a region to see how we think about entering it.

items.title: Africa is converging
items.text: The African Medicines Agency became operational in October 2025. East Africa already shares assessments across 7 regulators.

items.title: Eurasia is consolidating
items.text: National registrations not aligned to EAEU rules are being annulled in several member states. Kazakhstan's national route closes on 31 Dec 2027.

items.title: Central Asia is opening
items.text: Uzbekistan cut registration review times to 60–120 days in Nov 2025. Early filers get the head start.

items.title: An empty category, hiding in plain sight.
items.text: Twelve eye-care medicines on one market's essential list had no supplier at all, and a distributor was already asking for one of them.

items.title: A 'crowded' molecule that was wide open.
items.text: 53 listings on paper. Every one was for animal use. For human medicine, the market was open.
